title: Inés Gómez Mont Arrested in Florida; She Remained a Fugitive for 5 Years
author: Anahí Del Ángel
content:
_This article by[Anahí Del Ángel](https://contralinea.com.mx/author/anahida/)
originally appeared in the [October 30, 2026 edition of
Contralínea](https://contralinea.com.mx/interno/semana/detuvieron-en-florida-
a-ines-gomez-mont-permanecio-5-anos-profuga/), a Mexican investigative
journalism magazine._

After remaining a fugitive from Mexican justice for five years, former
television host **Inés Gómez Mont,** wife of businessman **Víctor Manuel
Álvarez Puga** , known as **the _King of the Invoice Mills_** , was arrested
in Florida by U.S. authorities.

Mexican authorities link the couple to a network of companies that invoice
simulated transactions, which allegedly allowed the diversion of around **3
billion pesos** from the budget of the **Secretariat of Governance,** during
the administration of **Enrique Peña Nieto.**

In 2021, a federal judge issued arrest warrants against both for the possible
commission of the crimes of**_money laundering_ , organized crime and
embezzlement**. Businessman Álvarez Puga is also being investigated for the
alleged illegal sale of **Pegasus licenses** , following the discovery of a
clandestine espionage center in **Santa Fe,** Mexico City, where hundreds of
recordings of officials were seized.

Just this past September 30, President **Claudia Sheinbaum** revealed that the
International Criminal Police Organization (Interpol) had removed the couple's
red notices, an action she questioned, stating that there is evidence to show
that in Mexico **" they were dedicated to invoicing businesspeople with fake
invoices to avoid paying taxes." **

Because she was detained in the United States, it will be that country's
authorities who determine **Inés Gómez Mont 's legal and migratory status**.
Meanwhile, Mexican authorities must carry out the corresponding procedure to
request her formal **extradition**.
